question: Can I activate an ability that prevents damage after a spell that would deal damage has already resolved?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you must do it in response to the spell, because once it resolves it is too late.
expected.answer: A player can activate an ability that prevents damage in response to a spell that would deal damage. Once the spell resolves, though, it’s too late to prevent the damage.
